name: Merab
bio: Merab was Saul's older daughter. Saul had earlier promised that whoever killed the Philistine Goliath would receive Merab in marriage (1 Samuel 17:25); after David killed Goliath, Saul had other plans — hoping to put David in danger, he told him, "I will give you my older daughter Merab as a wife; only serve me bravely and fight the battles of the LORD," while privately scheming to have the Philistines kill David rather than doing it himself (1 Samuel 18:17). David, considering himself unworthy, replied, "Who am I... that I should become the king's son-in-law?" But when the time came to give Merab to David, Saul instead gave her to Adriel of Meholah (1 Samuel 18:18-19). Merab's broken engagement, changed at her father's whim, reveals the dark scheming behind Saul's determination to be rid of David.
